Gross–Popescu establish the cubic model over characteristic zero, not this local bad-fiber normal form. value.rationale: The formal contact type is a motivated local invariant of the exceptional characteristic-eleven degeneration of the famous modular Klein cubic. The exponent-eleven versus exponent-twelve distinction is not decided by its known Tjurina length or quadratic rank, and influences the singularity/deformation questions one can ask. A structural local classification, not a routine parameter substitution.
